items.transcript: Hello everyone, how are we? Three weeks into the school summer holidays. It's been interesting guys. Three young boys. I think I've lost the plot. But today I have a few hours to myself. So I'm going to go around each room in the house and have a little potter. See what I want to get done. A little dust about. Do you know what I mean? I want that coke in a wine glass. I'm ready. Can we just talk about the basket? I've got the watch. Yeah, I'm back. Stop it. One. Two. I'm so hot. Jamie's pants. Perfect. Now I've got this bed in. Oh my dog. What's that? How do you open this? Oh happy day. 10 out of 10. Excuse me, I need to rock the floors. Oh no gooselings. I need to clean the floors. Oh my God. Mission hit. I bought some little tables for my chickens. Honey no lie. Oh at least the actual toilet roll made it out of the toilet, but just made it to the kitchen worktop. Happy days. I don't know why I bought these chicken tables. Sweet gem lettuce. All on the cob. Some blueberry. Raspberries. Strawberries. I'm a mum of three boys, so my chicken gum are girls, okay? Just leave me to it. Hey girls. Mama's got you a new table. Come on over. Get out. Enjoy. Off of you fluffies. And that's me over and out everyone. Enjoy your feast girls. All the best.
